Entry Horticulture and Floriculture of the Reach The gardens, herbs, and well-manicured avenues of the Reach are not only decorative but also a display of wealth and stability. The lord's wife can use the garden to show her upbringing, and the pharmacist can find materials from it, but the farmer knows that the beautiful flower border depends on a stable water source and the land that cannot be expropriated. Any break in the place of origin, checkpoints, shipping schedules, debts and protection fees will immediately make the nobles in the distance feel the changes in price and power.
